doc.brief: The QDataWidgetMapper class provides mapping between a section of a data model to widgets.
doc.index_brief: Mapping between a section of a data model to widgets

QByteArray mappedPropertyName(QWidget *w.brief: Returns the name of the property that is used when mapping data to the given *widget*.

QDataWidgetMapper(QObject *parent).brief: Constructs a new QDataWidgetMapper with parent object *parent*.

QDataWidgetMapper::SubmitPolicy submitPo.brief: This property holds the current submit policy

QWidget * mappedWidgetAt(int section) co.brief: Returns the widget that is mapped at *section*, or 0 if no widget is mapped at that section.

Qt::Orientation orientation() const.brief: This property holds the orientation of the model

bool submit().brief: Submits all changes from the mapped widgets to the model.

int currentIndex() const.brief: This property holds the current row or column

int mappedSection(QWidget *widget) const.brief: Returns the section the *widget* is mapped to or -1 if the widget is not mapped.

void addMapping(QWidget *widget, int sec.brief: Adds a mapping between a *widget* and a *section* from the model.
Essentially the same as addMapping(), but adds the possibility to specify the property to use specifying *propertyName*.

void currentIndexChanged(int index).brief: This signal is emitted after the current index has changed and all widgets were populated with new data. *index* is the new current index.

void removeMapping(QWidget *widget).brief: Removes the mapping for the given *widget*.

void revert().brief: Repopulates all widgets with the current data of the model.

void setCurrentIndex(int index).brief: This property holds the current row or column

void setCurrentModelIndex(const QModelIn.brief: Sets the current index to the row of the *index* if the orientation is horizontal (the default), otherwise to the column of the *index*.

void setOrientation(Qt::Orientation aOri.brief: This property holds the orientation of the model

void setSubmitPolicy(QDataWidgetMapper::.brief: This property holds the current submit policy

void toFirst().brief: Populates the widgets with data from the first row of the model if the orientation is horizontal (the default), otherwise with data from the first column.

void toLast().brief: Populates the widgets with data from the last row of the model if the orientation is horizontal (the default), otherwise with data from the last column.

void toNext().brief: Populates the widgets with data from the next row of the model if the orientation is horizontal (the default), otherwise with data from the next column.

void toPrevious().brief: Populates the widgets with data from the previous row of the model if the orientation is horizontal (the default), otherwise with data from the previous column.
